subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: The requested behavior is still missing on main, and two open overlapping PRs attempt the same fix with different proof and implementation signals.

options.title: Refresh the stronger proven PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable refreshing it on current main and preserving its formatter/test coverage.

options.title: Repair the same-author PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after it resolves conflicts and proof gaps.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Pause or close both overlapping branches and ask for one narrow generator/check PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh the stronger proven PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable refreshing it on current main and preserving its formatter/test coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the most recent current-main history on the central SecretRef docs generator/test files and is the best available routing owner for choosing a path.
